fusion_ranked_evidence.title: Lviv raises water tariff from August 1 to 56.38 UAH per m³ - Межа. Новини України.
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: ### Özgür Özel leaves CHP and launches new party with ninety MPs. 25 jul 2026, 06:24. ### Lviv raises water tariff from August 1 to 56.38 UAH per m³. From August 1, in Lviv, the tariff for water supply and wastewater will more than double – to 56.38 UAH per cubic meter. The decision was approved by the Executive Committee of the Lviv City Council, as announced by the City Council’s press service. > *From August 1, 2026, a new tariff for centralized water supply and wastewater disposal will be in effect in Lviv. According to the city council’s calculations, for a resident using 3 m³ of water per month, the bill for water supply and wastewater will rise by about 92 UAH. The city council also reminded that Lviv has one of the most complex water-supply systems in Ukraine – due to the city’s location on the Main European watershed, water is delivered over long distances through hundreds of kilometers of trunk pipelines.
